greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Ilaah ha idinla jirto, idinkoo maanta isugu yimid inaynu xusuusanno kuwa naga hor maray ee ku jira gacmaha Ilaah.
penitential: Sayidow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Sayidow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Sayidku waa adhijirkayga; waxba uma baahni.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka maanta ee akhriska koowaad: 'Sida dahabka foornada lagu tijaabiyo, ayuu iyaga u tijaabiyey.' Waxaa jira wakhtiyo nolosha ah oo dareemaya sida kuleylka foornadaas oo kale. Marka aan eegno nolosha Benjamin Vo—wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee caqliga badan, wiilka jeclaa diyaaradaha iyo inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines', wiilka qalbigiisa jilicsan uu ahaa mid aan la barbar dhigi karin—waxaan dareemeynaa in nolosha ay mararka qaarkood nagu adkeyd. Laakiin ereyada xikmaddu waxay inoo sheegayaan wax aan inoo rajada kordhinaya: 'Nafta kuwa xaqqa ah waxay ku jirtaa gacanta Ilaah.'

Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil nolosha u arkaayay indho xiiso leh. Waxaan xusuusannaa markii uu ahaa 12 jir, ee uu ilmeeyay dhalashadii aabbihiis, isagoo ka baqaya inuu lumiyo. Taasi waxay ahayd calaamad muujinaysa sida uu u jeclaa qoyskiisa. Thao iyo Alan, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo aad u culus. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad marar badan is weydiisaan: 'Maxay tani u dhacday? Ma waxaan ka gaabiyay daryeelka?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idin sheego runta: 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Sida Ciise u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey ninkii indhaha la'a, xanuunka iyo dhimashadu ma aha ciqaab, mana aha wax idinka idin yimid. Ma jiro wax aad seegteen, mana jiro wax aad ka gaabiseen. Ilaah idinma eedeynayo, ee waa inaan idinkuna naftiina eedeynin.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Dadka oo dhan oo Aabbuhu i siiyo ayaa ii iman doona, qofkii ii yimaadana ma eryi doono.' Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa gacmahaas aan marnaba eryin qofkii u yimaada. Wuxuu la joogaa Ilaah, isagoo xor ka ah wax walba oo xanuun ahaa. Sida riyadii aad aragteen, markii Ben uu ku yiri: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết,' wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inuu imtixaankii nolosha si buuxda u dhaafay. Wuxuu hadda ku jiraa meel nabad ah, isagoo idin ka daawanaya xagga sare.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Xusuuso riyadii aad ku aragtay idinkoo ku jira 'roller coaster'. Jacaylka idin ka dhaxeeya waa mid aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil rabay inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Inkastoo aan loo baahan, haddana rabitaankaas saafi ah ee uu lahaa inuu wax dhiibo waa calaamad muujinaysa in jacaylkiisu uu weli nool yahay. Waxa uu inoo reebay waa jacaylkaas. Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar: Ha is-edeynin. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa mid weli Ben la socda. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jeclahay wax walba oo ka sarreeya, waxaana rabaa inaan kugu qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana isu dhiibayaa gebi ahaanba adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Nabaddu Ilaah ha idinla jirto, isagoo idin siinaya rajo iyo xoog maalin kasta. Ilaah ha idinku barakeeyo.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga hor maray, inuu Ilaah ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinkiisa weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah siiyo nabad, rajo, iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Nafta kuwa xaqqa ah waxay ku jirtaa gacanta Ilaah, mana jiro xanuun taaban doona. Kuwii nacasnimada u haystay inay dhinteen, dhimashadoodana loo haystay inay tahay masiibo, iyo inay naga tageen inay tahay burbur, laakiin waxay ku jiraan nabad. Haddii dadka hortooda lagu ciqaabay, rajadoodu waxay ka buuxdaa nolol weligeed ah; in yar oo la edbiyey, ayaa si weyn loo barakayn doonaa, maxaa yeelay Ilaah baa tijaabiyey oo u helay inay isaga u qalmaan. Sida dahabka foornada lagu tijaabiyo, ayuu iyaga u tijaabiyey, oo sida qurbaan ayuu u qaatey. Marka la soo booqdo, way iftiimi doonaan, oo waxay u duuli doonaan sida dhimbiilaha cawska dhexdiisa. Waxay xukumi doonaan quruumaha, Sayidkuna wuxuu ahaan doonaa Boqorkooda weligiis. Kuwii isaga aaminay waxay fahmi doonaan runta, kuwa aaminka ahna waxay kula joogi doonaan jacayl; maxaa yeelay nimcada iyo naxariistu waxay la jiraan kuwa quduuska ah, daryeelkiisuna wuxuu la jiraa kuwa uu doortay.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, rajadu kuma niyad jabiso, maxaa yeelay jacaylka Ilaah waxaa lagu shubay qalbiyadeenna Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo layna siiyey. Maxaa yeelay Masiixu, markii aynu weli daciif ahayn, ayuu u dhintay kuwa cibaadada daran waqtigii loo qabtay. Way adag tahay in qof u dhinto qof xaq ah, inkastoo laga yaabo in qof wanaagsan loo dhinto. Laakiin Ilaah wuxuu muujiyey jacaylkiisa inuu inoo qabo, markii aynu weli dembiilayaal ahayn, Masiixu inoo dhintay. Intee in leeg ayaynu hadda, oo dhiiggiisa lagu xaqiijiyey, aynu ka badbaadi doonaa cadhada. Maxaa yeelay haddii, markii aynu cadow ahayn, laynaga heshiisiiyey Ilaah dhimashada Wiilkiisa, intee in leeg ayaynu, hadda oo aynu heshiinay, aynu ku badbaadi doonaa noloshiisa. Taas oo keliya ma aha, laakiin waxaan ku faanaa Ilaah xagga Sayidkeenna Ciise Masiix, kaas oo aynu hadda ku helnay heshiisiinta.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu dadkii u yiri: 'Dadka oo dhan oo Aabbuhu i siiyo ayaa ii iman doona, qofkii ii yimaadana ma eryi doono, maxaa yeelay waxaan ka imid samada si aanan u samayn rabitaankayga, laakiin rabitaanka kii i soo diray. Tani waa rabitaanka kii i soo diray, inaanan lumin wax kasta oo uu i siiyey, laakiin inaan maalinta ugu dambaysa sara kiciyo. Maxaa yeelay tani waa rabitaanka Aabbahay, in qof kasta oo Wiilka arka oo rumaysta uu helo nolol weligeed ah, aniguna maalinta ugu dambaysa waan sara kicin doonaa.'

day: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
